instruction: DDR3 Byte Lane Length Matching The file `/home/user/Desktop/ddr3.kicad_pcb` contains a DDR3 byte lane with 11 nets routed on F.Cu: DQS_P, DQS_N (the reference pair at 35 mm each), DQ0-DQ7, and DM. The DQ and DM traces are currently unmatched, ranging from approximately 28 mm to 34 mm. Add serpentine segments to the DQ0-DQ7 and DM nets to match the DQS reference length. Do NOT modify the DQS_P or DQS_N traces. Requirements: 1. The maximum minus minimum length across all 11 nets must be <= 150 um. 2. DQS_P and DQS_N lengths must remain within +/-0.1 mm of their input values. 3. Serpentine bends must maintain at least 0.2 mm spacing between net traces (3H rule for 0.1 mm trace width); bends must stay within 1.5 mm of their track's y-center. 4. All segments must remain on F.Cu. 5. The output file must parse as a valid KiCad PCB s-expression. 6. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board. Write /home/user/Desktop/ddr3.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg. [Software] Use KiCad 10.0.2; run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path). For this task, the installed KiCad tools are `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/pcbnew`, and `/usr/bin/eeschema`; use the one that matches the board or schematic operation.
